title: Spidertouch
summary: Spidertouch is a spell that allows the casting Seeker to cling to any surface, regardless of the material that it is made of. When it is cast, a sticky, web-like substance extends out of the fingertips of the caster and connects with whatever the Seeker is trying to cling to. Spidertouch can also allow the Seeker to shoot out a web to either entangle an opponent or create a web to keep the Seeker from falling. These abilities make this spell handy for grappling and immobilizing.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Dante Vale used Spidertouch to cling onto Ymir during the mission The Hammer of Thor, making the giant Titan fall into a nearby canyon. [The Legacy of Thor] Inside a ship belonging to Atlanta sunk in the Stavropolous River, Dante Vale used this spell once again to grab the Sword of Saint George from DeFoe's hands, with which he was holding Sophie Casterwill hostage. [The Treasures of the Argonauts]

In the outskirts of Vienna, Austria, Dante Vale used Spidertouch with the help of Hyperstride to grab onto an Organization helicopter trying to stop them from entering Klaus' Bookshop. With the spell's help, Dante is able to stay firmly gripped to the helicopter and invoke Metagolem, bringing it down. [The Bookshop Hunter]

At some point, LeBlanche used Spidertouch to restrain two Suits. [TCG:SAS-114]

Lok Lambert used the spell to fight off a pair of thugs when looking for Den Fears in the streets of Venice, restraining one of them to a nearby log. [Boys Will Be Seekers] It was later used by Lok to save himself from falling from a narrow bridge, part of the Trial of Courage inside the Fortress of Iron Will. [Sophie on Trial]

Guggenheim used this spell in conjunction with Ironhand to break apart a wooden plank from the ceiling of the Hamelin Cathedral, falling onto several Gremlow Titans. [Gremlow Infestation!]

Dante Vale and Den Fears both used an orange aura Spidertouch spell to restrain Shauna during a surprise attack inside the Phoenix Volcano. [The Phoenix's Ashes] Den later used the spell once again to stop Cherit from eating a loaf of bread Den wanted to eat during the team's rest at the Lambert House. [Back Home]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
* [[Lok Lambert]]'s use of Spidertouch in episode 36, "[[Boys Will Be Seekers]]" is an allusion to [[wikipedia:Spider-Man|Spider-Man]].
* In the TCG, [[SAS-024|SAS-024 - Zhalia Moon]] grants a bonus whenever she uses this spell.
* When Dante Vale and Den Fears use the spell in the episode "[[The Phoenix's Ashes]]", its aura is orange instead of the usual blue.
